theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_ud_isClosed_cone_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ρ : ℝ) (s : ℝ≥0∞), IsClosed F → ContinuousOn (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) F → IsClosed {x | x ∈ F ∧ μ ({z | 2 * ‖(Q x).starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ) ≤ s}
